provenance.notes: Original procedural fictional squads. No official club or player affiliation.
Original procedural fictional squads. No official club or player affiliation.

methodology.possession: Percentage of actual engine-recorded controlled-ball seconds for either team; loose/contested balls have no owner and are excluded. No inferred possession from pass volume.
methodology.passes: A pass launch resolves once on the next actual ball-control/ball-played by another teammate; restarts, shots, fouls and opposing controls terminate it. Progression is at least 8 metres in that period attack direction.
methodology.assists: Engine-recorded assistId on a goal, credited only to a teammate distinct from the scorer; no retrospective invented attribution.
methodology.minutes: Lineup and substitution/red-card active intervals over the simulated match clock, including added time/extra time but excluding shootout.
methodology.availability: Shots on target and individual interceptions are unavailable because an exact validated feed is absent. Expected goals remain in the developer lab.
methodology.rating: tm-event-rating-1: neutral 6, bounded diminishing returns. GK/DEF/MID/FWD weights respectively: goals 1.5/1.5/1.4/1.6; assists .9/.9/1/1; progression .25/.5/.75/.45; tackles .25/.7/.5/.35; saves 1.1/.9/.9/.9. Attack total cap 2.8; discipline max -2, recorded miscontrol max -.3. Safe pass volume earns zero. Ratings need 15 minutes; cup leaders need 90 cumulative minutes.

rating.limitations: Event-based actions only. Safe pass volume is not rewarded; off-ball work and counterfactual errors are not evaluated.
